boundaries.evidence: From about y~330 px down to S2 a thin white line runs at x~143-146 and continues as the bright white edge of a raised median island (island spans x~70-135 from y~590 px to a rounded nose at y~1170 px). The edge bulges to x~149-150 near S3 and curves back to x~128 at the nose. The opposing approach, with its stop bar at x~0-60, y~1095 px, lies left of the island. At S1 the line sits in a dark shaded/occluded patch where only a faint streak near x~134 shows, so S1 is estimated. S5 lies just past the island nose with no marking and is extrapolated from the nose.
Clear solid white line, left edge of a hatched buffer (two parallel solid lines about 20 crop units apart joined by diagonal white hatch bars), running the full height to the crosswalk.
Clear solid white line, right edge of the hatched buffer. The strip to its right carries a white bicycle symbol near S4 (x~270-285).

Edge between the grey bicycle-lane surface and the lighter concrete sidewalk, which carries a row of tree pits (dark squares, x~293-320) and round street furniture right at the edge. It is a tonal edge rather than a line. At S4 the bicycle symbol and furniture blur it, so the value is interpolated.

partial_strips: Left of the left limit, a raised median island (x~70-135) starts at y~590 px (between S2 and S3) and ends in a rounded nose at y~1170 px, just above S5. Below the nose the surface between the opposing lanes and the target lane is open and unmarked down to the crosswalk.
Opposing carriageway to the far left (x<~70), with a stop bar at x~0-60, y~1095 px; excluded.
cannot_determine: The top-left of the crop is dark (shadow or a leaning structure) down a diagonal from about x~220 at the top edge to x~0 at y~560 px. The left limit at S1 cannot be seen clearly; a faint streak at x~134 there may or may not be the same line, which is at x~143 just below the dark area.
No line is visible inside the ~80-90 crop-unit (about 4.5-5 m) strip between the left limit and the hatched buffer; whether it is one wide lane cannot be confirmed from paint.
The kerb line is a soft tonal edge, with an uncertainty of about 3-5 crop units.
